title: Final velocity v0
description: Essential: Correctly states the uniform velocity of rod a as v0 = (2mgR sinθ)/(B²L²).

title: Final acceleration a0
description: Essential: Correctly states the initial acceleration of rod b as a0 = 2g sinθ.

title: Final common velocity v
description: Essential: Correctly states the common velocity as v = g sinθ * t0 + (mgR sinθ)/(B²L²).

title: Relative distance Δx
description: Essential: Correctly states the relative distance as Δx = (2m²R²g sinθ)/(B⁴L⁴).

title: Force balance for rod a
description: Important: Applies equilibrium (mg sinθ = BIL) to rod a when it moves uniformly.

title: Circuit analysis for current
description: Important: Uses Ohm's law and Faraday's law to find the induced current I = (BLv)/(2R).

title: Momentum theorem application
description: Important: Applies the impulse-momentum theorem separately to each rod during the time t0.

title: Average induced EMF
description: Optional: Correctly relates average EMF to the relative displacement (E_avg = BLΔx/t0).

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong sign for magnetic force in Newton's second law for either rod.

title: Incorrect circuit resistance
description: Pitfall: Uses R instead of 2R for the total circuit resistance in current calculations.
